structuralConcept.atriumSupport: Trim second-floor slab and highest roof around the aligned aperture; enclosure and trimmer supports must be coordinated with the lower structure. Preserve the clear vertical sightline.
structuralConcept.landingReturnSupport: The final 150 mm wall band follows the existing lightwell wall directly below; slab cutout and clear lightwell stay unchanged.
structuralConcept.status: Concept only: design foundations, continuous load paths, new bedroom edge support and roof, approach landing and stair waist, seismic system and saturated planter loads before construction.
